cpu_driver:
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_compare', root / 'benchmarks/audit/compare.py')
audit = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(audit)
output = root / 'benchmarks/audit/build/stack-timings'
for name in sorted(audit.DEFAULTS):
    before = root / 'benchmarks/audit/build/stack-before' / name
    after = root / 'benchmarks/audit/build/stack-after' / name
    expected = output / f'{name}.expected.txt'
    expected.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output([str(before / 'rust'), str(audit.DEFAULTS[name])]))
    command = [sys.executable, str(root / 'benchmarks/audit/variants.py'),
               '--expected', str(expected), '--size', str(audit.DEFAULTS[name]),
               '--profile-size', str(audit.AUDIT[name]), '--runs', '21', '--cpu', '1',
               '--report', str(output / f'{name}.json'),
               f'before={before}/fa/native/main', f'after={after}/fa/native/main']
    print(name, ' '.join(command), flush=True)
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)

limitations: General caller return destinations for user functions, objects and tuples remain in design/todo.md
map/filter/from, empty-separator split and other fresh collection constructors retain their existing allocation paths
Runtime object Columnar/GrowingColumnar chunks exceed the stack budget; constants use aligned read-only globals
Static lowering does not yet cover interpreter-evaluated initializers, defaults, optional/enum/union values, or 128-bit/composite table keys; these keep the ordinary frame/heap path
Deferred iterators, bound methods, unknown uses, captures, foreign exposure and async code conservatively choose the heap
Bytes does not exist in this branch; some existing methods still use temporary flat views
The 4 KiB budget bounds additional collection space per frame, not total recursion depth; freestanding has no stack overflow stop handler
